name: Machine Seated Good Morning
steps: Sit with your feet flat and adjust the padded lever so it rests across your upper back, clear of your neck.
Grip the handles lightly, brace your core tightly, and keep your chest lifted with a neutral spine.
Hinge forward smoothly from your hips, leaning your torso down between your thighs until you feel a strong stretch across your glutes and hamstrings.
Press your feet into the floor and extend your hips until your torso is upright.
tips: Keep your spine straight throughout the hinge rather than rounding your lower back.
Stop folding forward as soon as you feel your pelvis beginning to tuck under.
